_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: goals
constraints: CHECK (priority IS NULL OR priority BETWEEN 1 AND 3)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conferences" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "venue" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "role_type" TEXT NULL, "role_text" TEXT NULL, "requested_outputs" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_recording_profile" TEXT NOT NULL, "policy_acknowledged_at" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "conference_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conferences (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "text" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (priority IS NULL OR priority BETWEEN 1 AND 3));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_types" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_builtin" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activities" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "conference_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conferences (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_types (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "speaker_names" TEXT NOT NULL, "organisation" TEXT NULL, "room" TEXT NULL, "notes_md" TEXT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_start" TEXT NULL, "actual_start" TEXT NULL, "actual_end" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_permission_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_profile_override" TEXT NULL, "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), "contact_name" TEXT NULL, "contact_details" TEXT NULL, "follow_up_text" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recording_segments" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "requested_profile" TEXT NOT NULL, "codec" TEXT NOT NULL, "container" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sample_rate_hz" INTEGER NOT NULL, "requested_bitrate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "observed_bitrate_bps" INTEGER NULL, "input_route" TEXT NULL, "start_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_utc" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "end_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("activity_id", "sequence"), CHECK (sequence > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "interruptions" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_utc" TEXT NULL, "auto_resumed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("auto_resumed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "thumbnail_path" TEXT NULL, "taken_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "offset_ms" INTEGER NULL, "caption" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "original_kept" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("original_kept" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bookmarks" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "at_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "offset_ms" INTEGER NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cut_ranges" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_offset_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_offset_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (start_offset_ms >= 0), CHECK (end_offset_ms > start_offset_ms));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "export_jobs" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "conference_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conferences (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination" TEXT NOT NULL, "format" TEXT NOT NULL, "audio_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes_total" INTEGER NULL, "bytes_done" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "verification_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
